lines.japanese: 「ふぅぅ」
lines.english: “Phewww.”

lines.japanese: あー、落ちつくなぁー……。
lines.english: Ahh, now this is relaxing...

lines.japanese: えーと、まー、どーでもいいことなんですけどー。
lines.english: Umm, well, this is totally unimportant, but...

lines.japanese: 玄関はその家の顔、なーんて言うじゃないですか。んーじゃ、トイレは人体のどこに当たりますかね。
lines.english: People call the entrance the face of a home, don't they? So what part of the human body would the toilet be?

lines.japanese: 俺に言わせれば……そう、母親の胎内ってとこすかね。分かります？　この俗世から隔離された、絶対的な安心感。
lines.english: If you ask me... why, the mother's womb. You see it, don't you? That absolute security, sealed away from the vulgar world outside.

lines.japanese: こうね、直方体の繭の中、ひとり白亜の安楽椅子に座しているだけで、俺は俺の原風景へと還り、つかの間の安心立命を得ることが出来るわけですよ。
lines.english: Here I sit alone in my rectangular cocoon, enthroned upon an ivory chair of ease, and return to the primal landscape of my being. For one fleeting moment, I attain perfect peace of body and soul.

lines.japanese: ですからね、たとえば外に出てて、さあなにか食べようってとき、店を選ぶ基準のひとつには洗面所の良し悪しってのがあって然るべきだと思うんですよ。
lines.english: So, y'know, when you're out and decide to grab something to eat, I think how good the bathroom is should be one of the things you use to pick a place.

lines.japanese: ね、ほら、見てください？
lines.english: Just look, will you?

lines.japanese: どーです。綺麗でしょ、この店のトイレ。おそれ多くて壁に落書きとか出来ないでしょ。レバーとか足で踏んづけらんないでしょ。
lines.english: What do you think? Beautiful, isn’t it, this restaurant’s toilet? You wouldn’t dare scribble on the wall. You couldn’t bring yourself to stomp the lever with your foot.

lines.japanese: ええ、さすがです。おしゃれな店構えと、そのわりに気取らない明るさとが好評の、洋食レストラン『アレキサンダー』。素晴らしい。情報誌に（小さくだけど）載るような人気店は、化粧室もかくあるべきです。
lines.english: Yes, excellent. Alexander, the Western-style restaurant people love for its stylish exterior and bright, unpretentious atmosphere. Wonderful. A popular place that makes it into a dining magazine—even in tiny print—ought to have a powder room like this.

lines.japanese: だって見てください？　まずほら、便座が木目。金具は金色。大理石風のタイルと無駄に広い空間がまた、大胆かつエレガントな高級感を演出していますよね。
lines.english: I mean, look at it. First, the toilet seat has a wood grain. Gold fittings. Fake marble tiles and way too much space, all coming together to create this bold yet elegant feeling of luxury, right?

lines.japanese: 優しい芳香に包まれた安らぎのリフレッシュスペース。これならお子様からお年寄りまで、未来への夢を切りひらく快適なアウトプットをお楽しみいただけることでしょう。
lines.english: A restful refreshment space enfolded in gentle fragrance. Here, patrons from children to senior citizens may enjoy a comfortable output that opens the way to dreams of tomorrow.

lines.japanese: いやあ、トイレって本当にいいものですね。
lines.english: Ahh, toilets really are wonderful things.

lines.japanese: 「ギャルと合コンがしたい」
lines.english: “I want a group date with some party girls.”

lines.japanese: 手を拭きながらカウンター席に戻ると、マスターが常連客のカケルくん相手に男気あふれる夢を語っていました。
lines.english: When I got back to my seat at the counter, drying my hands, the boss was telling Kakeru, another regular, all about his manly dream.

lines.japanese: 「あ、そう」
lines.english: “Oh. Okay.”

lines.japanese: カケルくんというのは、ご覧のとおり容姿と体型と身長に恵まれた青年です。休日の昼下がりに柳木原のメインストリートを歩けば、すぐにカメラとファッション誌の名刺を持った方が寄ってくるような青年です。
lines.english: Kakeru, as you can see, is a young guy blessed with the whole package: face, build, height. If he walks down Yanagihara's main street on a weekend afternoon, someone with a camera and a fashion magazine business card will be on him in no time.

lines.japanese: そして、そんなオサレなファッション誌にオサレなカットを載せたりしながら職業イラストレーターを目指しているという、妬みたくなるぐらいクールでスマートな青年です。
lines.english: And on top of that, he's aiming to become a professional illustrator while putting stylish little illustrations in those stylish magazines. He's so cool and put-together it almost makes you wanna hate him.

lines.japanese: そんな彼のモテクション（モテモテコネクション）にすがれば、たしかにマスターの夢……いやさ俺たちの夢は、現実のものになるかもしれません。
lines.english: If we lean on his chick-nections—his vast network of connections with the ladies—the boss's dream... no, our dream might actually come true.

lines.japanese: 俺は思わずウェットタオルをその辺に放りなげました。
lines.english: Without thinking, I flung my wet towel aside.

lines.japanese: 「賛成！　賛成！　合コン賛成！」
lines.english: “I'm in! I'm in! All hail the group date!”

lines.japanese: 呑気に手なんか拭いている場合じゃありません。
lines.english: This was no time to be leisurely drying my hands.

lines.japanese: 独身男３５歳の熱いソウルに心を打たれた俺は、もはやその場に立ちつくすことなどできずスツールに飛びのり、カウンター越しにマスターこと軽部狩男の両手を握りしめていました。
lines.english: Moved by the burning soul of a thirty-five-year-old bachelor, I could no longer stand still. I leapt onto my stool, reached across the counter, and seized both hands of Karuo Karube, whom we called the boss.
“Magnificent!”

lines.japanese: 「素晴らしい、さすがですマスター！　俺はいつだって、アナタのように大胆かつ野心的なオピニオンリーダーの後塵を拝したいと願っていました！　マーベラス！　さすが、パセリを食べられる男は言うことが違う！」
lines.english: “Magnificent! I knew we could count on you, boss! I’ve always yearned to follow in the footsteps of a bold and ambitious opinion leader like you! Marvelous! A man who can eat his parsley truly speaks on another level!”

lines.japanese: 「はっはっはっ、落ちつけ鷲介。こいつ、興奮して早くも手に汗かいていやがるな。まるでトイレ帰りのだらしない男の子みたいじゃないか」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha! Calm down, Shusuke. Look at you, already sweating with excitement. You’re like some careless little boy who’s just come back from the toilet.”

lines.japanese: マスターは人聞きの悪いたとえを用いて俺を揶揄したあと、ふたたびカケルくんの方へ向きなおりました。
lines.english: After taunting me with this deeply prejudicial comparison, the boss turned back to Kakeru.

lines.japanese: 「──というわけだ、カケル。男性陣は数が揃った。あとは、雷が鳴ると耳を塞いでうずくまってしまうような初々しい少女を三人ばかり調達してきてくれ」
lines.english: “And there we are, Kakeru. The gentlemen's side is complete. All that remains is for you to procure three innocent young ladies who crouch and cover their ears whenever thunder rolls.”

lines.japanese: 「やだ」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: カケルくんは頭に被さったウェットタオルを剥がしながら、無気力きわまる態度で答えました。
lines.english: Peeling the wet towel off his head, Kakeru answered with consummate apathy.
“Wh-what?!”

lines.japanese: いい感じにテンションの上がってきた俺は、わざわざ熱血少年漫画風の暑苦しい驚き方を熱演しながら、彼の冷淡な横顔に目を瞠りました。
lines.english: Now that I had built up a proper head of steam, I put on an extravagantly overwrought display of shock, straight out of a boys’ action comic, and gaped at his impassive profile.

lines.japanese: 見られていることに気付いていながら、カケルくんは知らんぷりで煙草に火を点けます。クール＆ドライな彼に対抗して、俺は負けじとホット＆ウェットなキャラを続けることにしました。
lines.english: Though perfectly aware of my stare, Kakeru ignored me and lit a cigarette. To counter his cool-and-dry routine, I resolved to persevere with my hot-and-wet persona.

lines.japanese: 「た、大変だマスター！　どうやらカケルくんの好みは、守ってあげたい怖がり屋さんじゃないらしい！」
lines.english: “B-boss, we’ve got a problem! Apparently Kakeru doesn’t go for timid little things who make you want to protect them!”

lines.japanese: 「そうか。ならば仕方ない、曇り空の海岸で脱いだ靴を両手に棒立ちするフシギ系少女に変更だ」
lines.english: “I see. Then we have no choice. Change the order to a mysterious girl standing stock-still on a beach under a gray sky, her shoes in both hands.”
“That’s it!”

lines.japanese: 「素晴らしい、さすがですマスター！　目の付け所が内角いっぱい！　アンニュイな唇半開き顔で週刊誌のグラビアを飾る、微熱少女気取りのＢ級アイドルが目に浮かぶようです！」
lines.english: “Magnificent! I knew we could count on you, boss! You’ve got an eye for the inside corner! I can see her now: a B-list idol posing for a weekly magazine photo spread, lips parted, affecting the languor of a girl with a slight fever!”

lines.japanese: 「うむ──というわけだ。頼んだぞ、カケル」
lines.english: “Quite. And so, Kakeru, we leave it to you.”

lines.japanese: 「頼んだぞ、カケルくん」
lines.english: “We leave it to you, Kakeru.”

lines.japanese: 「やだって」
lines.english: “I said no.”

lines.japanese: 「裏切りの街角！？」
lines.english: “Betrayal on a Street Corner?!”

lines.japanese: 「おいカケル、なんださっきから嫌だ嫌だと。こっちがちょっとばかり甘やかなマスクをしていれば、調子に乗って我侭ばかり……俺たちにどこまで妥協しろと言うんだ。熟女か。団地妻か。淫乱肉奴隷か」
lines.english: “Now see here, Kakeru. What is this endless 'no, no, no'? Just because we happen to have sweet, handsome faces, you think you can grow spoiled and make unreasonable demands? How far must we compromise? Mature women? Housing-project wives? Depraved sex slaves?”

lines.japanese: 「なんでもいいってば。だから、やるなら俺抜きでやってよ」
lines.english: “I told you, I don’t care. If you’re doing it, do it without me.”

lines.japanese: ふぅーっと煙幕を張って、脇によけてあった俺の原稿用紙にいまさら目を落とすカケルくん。
lines.english: Blowing a smokescreen, Kakeru belatedly lowered his eyes to the manuscript pages I had set aside.

lines.japanese: 「ばかっ！　カケルくんのばかっ、この人でなし！　エゴイスト！　花粉症！」
lines.english: “Idiot! You idiot, Kakeru! You inhuman beast! Egoist! Hay-fever sufferer!”

lines.japanese: 「見くびるなよ、このホスト顔！　こんなにも非生産的な会話を日常的に交わしている俺たちが、カケルくんの桃色ネットワークなしにギャルと茶会なんて絵空事を実現できると思っているのか！」
lines.english: “Don’t underestimate us, you host-club pretty boy! We have conversations this unproductive every day. Do you honestly think we could make the fantasy of afternoon tea with girls come true without your connections with the ladies?”

lines.japanese: 「えー、できるよ。うん。きっとシュウちゃんならできる」
lines.english: “Sure you could. Yeah. If anyone can do it, Shu can.”

lines.japanese: 「……カケルくん、俺の目を見て話してごらん」
lines.english: “...Kakeru, look me in the eyes when you say that.”

lines.japanese: 「それにさー、マスター彼女いんじゃん」
lines.english: “Besides, the boss already has a girlfriend.”

lines.japanese: 「人のことはいい。カケルくん、俺の目を見なさい」
lines.english: “Never mind him. Kakeru, look me in the eyes.”

lines.japanese: 「てかさー、マスターもう結婚すんでしょ？　来月結納だっけ？」
lines.english: “I mean, isn't the boss getting married soon? The formal betrothal is next month, right?”

lines.japanese: 「ハッピー直前！？」
lines.english: “On the brink of happiness?!”

lines.japanese: 「く、くそっ、さてはこの蝶ネクタイ！　俺をたばかったな、恋に恋する無邪気なオトコ心をもてあそんだな！　ちくしょう、あんたなんかお定まりの人生墓場で、末永く惰性の愛欲にまみれるがいいさ！」
lines.english: “D-damn you, Bow Tie! You deceived me! You toyed with the innocent heart of a man in love with love! Curse you! Enter that conventional graveyard called marriage and wallow forever in the stale lust of habit!”

lines.japanese: 「うむ……鷲介、おまえの言う通りだ。俺の気ままなシングルライフはあと半年で終焉を迎える」
lines.english: “Indeed... You are right, Shusuke. In six months, my carefree bachelor life will meet its end.”

lines.japanese: 「なればこそだ。分かるだろう。なればこそ、俺は残された有限の時を悔いなく過ごしたいのだ」
lines.english: “Which is precisely why. Surely you understand. Precisely why I wish to spend the finite time remaining to me without regret.”

lines.japanese: 「はっ……！　そ、そうだったのか！」
lines.english: “Ah...! S-so that was it!”
“Magnificent!”

lines.japanese: 「素晴らしい、さすがですマスター！　土壇場のネバーギブアップ！　避妊に失敗した上でなおその往生際の悪さ、これほど前向きなマリッジブルーはレディースコミックの中でしか見たことがありません！」
lines.english: “Magnificent, as expected of you, Master! A last-minute never-give-up! Even after botching contraception, you still refuse to know when you're beaten. I've only seen pre-wedding blues this positive in ladies' comics!”

lines.japanese: 「この期に及んで、他の女と面倒起こさない方がいいんじゃなーい？　マスター、もう充分遊んだでしょー」
lines.english: “Wouldn’t it be smarter not to start trouble with another woman now? You’ve already had plenty of fun, boss.”

lines.japanese: 「待てカケル、おまえは何か勘違いをしている。俺たちはなにも乱交パーティーを開こうと言ってるわけじゃない。合コンだ合コン。合同コンドームじゃないぞ、合同コンパだ」
lines.english: “Wait, Kakeru. You misunderstand. We’re not proposing an orgy. It’s a singles mixer, not a swingers’ mixer. Condoms needn’t enter into it.”

lines.japanese: ああ、そうそう。言いわすれてましたけど、マスターはその無駄に渋い声で、シモ入ってる低俗なジョークを会話に盛りこむのが大好きなんで……ええ、我慢してください。俺たちも我慢しています。
lines.english: Ah, yes. I forgot to mention that the boss adores delivering vulgar jokes with that needlessly dignified voice of his... Please bear with him. The rest of us do.

lines.japanese: 「分かるかカケル。俺は風聞するところの自己紹介合戦や山手線ゲームや連れションミーティングを、一度でいいから体験しておきたいだけなんだ。いかがわしい下心など微塵もないこともない」
lines.english: “Do you understand, Kakeru? I merely wish to experience, once in my life, those legendary battles of self-introduction, round-robin category games, and strategic councils held during group trips to the restroom. It is not entirely true that I possess no sordid ulterior motive.”

lines.japanese: 「あるんじゃん」
lines.english: “So you do.”

lines.japanese: 「てへへ」
lines.english: “Tee hee.”

lines.japanese: 「うっ、ううぅ……察してあげてくれ、カケルくん。仕方ないじゃないか……おとこ桜が乱れ咲く、硬派街道・地獄変だったんだよ、青春時代のマスターは！　あと俺も！」
lines.english: “P-please try to understand him, Kakeru. He couldn't help it... The boss's youth was a riot of manly cherry blossoms—a hard man's road to hell! Mine too!”

lines.japanese: 「カケル、俺はな、この薬指に枷をはめられるまでのあいだ、少しでも多く若者たちの文化に触れておきたいのだ。その人類学的探究心をおまえは疑うというのか」
lines.english: “Kakeru, until a shackle closes around this ring finger, I wish to acquaint myself with as much youth culture as I can. Would you cast doubt upon so pure an anthropological impulse?”

lines.japanese: 「いいえ健全ですマスター！　清く正しく美しいです！　あなたの心はニジマスの養殖に使われる清水のごとく澄んでいる！　さすが！　さすがシャンプーするとき目を開けている男は言うことが違う！」
lines.english: “Never, boss! It is wholesome! Pure, upright, and beautiful! Your heart is as clear as the spring water used to raise rainbow trout! I knew it! A man who keeps his eyes open while shampooing truly speaks on another level!”

lines.japanese: 「え、じゃ合コンとか言って、ただ集まって飲んで騒ぐだけ？」
lines.english: “So when you say group date, you only mean getting together, drinking, and making noise?”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん、そうだけど……」
lines.english: “Y-yes. That’s what I mean...”

lines.japanese: 「アフターなし？　テイクアウトなし？　ふーん。本当につまんなそうだね、それ」
lines.english: “No after-party? No taking anyone home? Huh. That sounds genuinely boring.”

lines.japanese: 「へ……？　あ、あれ、そうですか？」
lines.english: “What...? Wait, does it?”

lines.japanese: 「うん。それ合コンって言わないよ。合コンごっこだよ」
lines.english: “Yeah. That isn't a group date. You're playing at having one.”

lines.japanese: ときおり感じるのですが、カケルくんは我々のような顔面庶民とは異なる文化圏で育っているため、しばしば俗世の枠を超越した不可思議な人生観を垣間見せることがあります。
lines.english: Sometimes it occurs to me that Kakeru was raised in a cultural sphere entirely separate from ours—the ordinary-faced commoners. Now and then, he grants us a glimpse of a strange philosophy of life that transcends the bounds of our mundane world.

lines.japanese: <-4>\「そ、そういうもんなんすかマスター。はぐれ無職純情系の自分には、彼の言ってることがさっぱり理解できません」
lines.english: “I-is that how it works, boss? As a wayward, unemployed romantic myself, I haven’t the faintest idea what he means.”

lines.japanese: <-4>\「うろたえるな鷲介。やつの勝ち組フィロソフィに呑まれたら負けだ。異文化コミュニケーションだと思って、目を合わせず曖昧に微笑んでおけ」
lines.english: “Do not lose your head, Shusuke. If we let his winner’s philosophy overwhelm us, we’ve lost. Treat it as cross-cultural communication: avoid his eyes and smile vaguely.”

lines.japanese: <-4>\「なるほど。それなら俺の得意技です。日本男児のＮＯと言えない後ろ向き大和魂を、野郎の網膜に焼きつけてやりますよ。へへへ」
lines.english: “I see. That happens to be my specialty. I shall burn into his retinas the timid spirit of the Japanese male, forever incapable of saying no. Heh heh heh.”

lines.japanese: なんて、俺たちが声をひそめて白々しい密談をしていると──
lines.english: And as we whispered our way through this pitifully transparent little conspiracy—

lines.japanese: 「浪人、水もらえるー？」
lines.english: “Retaker, can I get some water?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、はぁーい」
lines.english: “Coming!”

lines.japanese: ──賢人会議にあぶれていたカケルくんは、俺たちに背を向ける格好で、手近にいたフロアスタッフへ空っぽのグラスを掲げておりました。
lines.english: —Kakeru, excluded from our council of sages, turned his back on us and raised his empty glass toward the nearest member of the floor staff.

lines.japanese: 「お待たせいたしましたあ」
lines.english: “Sorry to keep you waiting.”

lines.japanese: ミルク色のウォーターポットととろけるような営業スマイルを携えてやって来たのは、受験勉強の合間を縫ってアルバイトに勤しむ、予備校二年生の望月紀奈子さん。
lines.english: Approaching with a milk-white water pitcher and a meltingly professional smile was Kinako Mochizuki, in her second year at cram school, diligently working shifts between bouts of exam preparation.

lines.japanese: 二重まぶたの大きな瞳。ふっくらした肉厚の唇。なごみ系のお顔とグラマラスなお体が、今日もアレキサンダーのちょっぴり刺激的なユニフォームにとてもよく似合っておいでです。
lines.english: Large, double-lidded eyes. Full, softly rounded lips. Her soothing face and glamorous figure suited Alexander’s mildly provocative uniform wonderfully, as ever.

lines.japanese: 彼女がカケルくんのグラスに水を注いでいるすぐ横で、マスターはわざとらしく気付いていないふりをしながら、聞こえよがしな声量で話を続けるのでした。
lines.english: As she poured water into Kakeru’s glass, the boss continued at a volume plainly intended to be overheard, while making an elaborate show of not noticing her.

lines.japanese: 「そうだ鷲介、いいことを思いついたぞ。合コンなどと下世話な呼び方はせず、お客様との親睦会という名目で、うちの女子クルーを否応なしに出席させてしまおう」
lines.english: “Shusuke, I have it. We shall abandon the vulgar term 'group date.' Instead, under the pretext of a social gathering with our customers, we shall compel the female crew to attend.”
“That’s it!”

lines.japanese: 「素晴らしい、さすがですマスター！　職権濫用という言葉など歯牙にもかけないその雄々しき蛮勇！　きっとあなたなら、憲法１３条にさえ敢然と立ちむかうことが出来るでしょう！」
lines.english: “Magnificent! I knew we could count on you, boss! Such manly recklessness, scorning the very phrase 'abuse of authority'! A man like you could surely stand undaunted even against Article Thirteen of the Constitution!”

lines.japanese: 私ツッコミ入れた方がいい？　という優しげな笑顔で俺を見守りながら待機している紀奈子さん。ここはあえてスルーして、もう１ターンだけ小芝居続行。
lines.english: Kinako stood by and watched me with a gentle smile that asked whether she was supposed to supply the retort. I deliberately ignored her and continued the little performance for one more turn.

lines.japanese: 「ふーう、やれやれ。大胆きわまる妙案についついガラにもなくエキサイトしてしまった……なんだか喉が乾いてきたなあ、ちょっと水でも飲みたいところ──」
lines.english: “Phew. Goodness me. That extraordinarily daring proposal excited me quite out of character... My throat seems to have gone dry. If only I had a little water—”

lines.japanese: 「──って、おお！　なんと、ちょうどいいところに紀奈子さん＆水！」
lines.english: “—why, look! Kinako and water, arriving at the perfect moment!”

lines.japanese: 「はい、どーも紀奈子でーす」
lines.english: “Hello there, I’m Kinako!”

lines.japanese: 「水でーす」
lines.english: “I'm Water!”
“Magnificent!”

lines.japanese: 「素晴らしい、さすがです紀奈子さん！　ウェイトレスの鑑！　行きとどいた気配り＆細心のまめやかさ！　俺には今のあなたが、さながら水がめを持った神話世界の女神に見えます！」
lines.english: “Magnificent! I knew we could count on you, Kinako! A paragon of waitresses! Consideration beyond compare, joined to the most meticulous care! At this moment, you appear to me as a goddess of myth bearing a water jar!”

lines.japanese: 「はい、どーもビーナスでーす」
lines.english: “Hello there, I’m Venus!”

lines.japanese: 「水がめでーす」
lines.english: “And I'm the Water Jar!”

lines.japanese: 紀奈子さんはウォーターポットの底と胴体を持って、それを右肩の上に担ぎあげます。俺はその位置にグラスを運んで、女神さまの水がめから有りがたい恩恵を賜りました。
lines.english: Holding the base and body of the pitcher, Kinako hoisted it above her right shoulder. I moved my glass beneath it and received the goddess’s blessed bounty from her jar.

lines.japanese: ご覧のとおり望月紀奈子さんという方はとても心の広いお姉さんで、このようにタチの悪い雇用主や常連客にも、いつだって愛想の良い笑顔を絶やさずに対応してくださるのです。
lines.english: As you can see, Kinako Mochizuki is a woman of tremendous generosity. Even when confronted with a troublesome employer and regulars such as ourselves, she never fails to serve us with a pleasant smile.

lines.japanese: 基本は真面目なしっかりさんなのに、乗るときは乗るという柔軟な生き方が素敵というほかありません。
lines.english: Fundamentally earnest and dependable, yet always willing to play along when the moment calls for it—her flexible approach to life is nothing short of admirable.

lines.japanese: 「くはーっ！　うまかーっ！」
lines.english: “Khaaah! Delicious!”

lines.japanese: 俺はビーナスに頂いた水を一口ふくんでからさらに騒ぎたてました。
lines.english: I took a mouthful of the water Venus had bestowed upon me, then raised an even greater commotion.

lines.japanese: 「素晴らしい！　この口あたりのまろやかさ！　舌に残るほのかな甘さ！　そして日本人好みの絶妙な硬度！　完璧だ……紀奈子さん、こんなパーフェクトウォーター、いったいどこの山脈で汲んできたんですか！」
lines.english: “Magnificent! That rounded mouthfeel! That faint sweetness lingering on the tongue! And the exquisite hardness so perfectly suited to Japanese tastes! Flawless... Kinako, from what mountain range did you draw this perfect water?”

lines.japanese: 「角のコンビニで売ってるよー」
lines.english: “They sell it at the convenience store on the corner.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな近場にアルプスが！」
lines.english: “The Alps were so close at hand!”

lines.japanese: 「で、浪人はここで油を売ってるだけと」
lines.english: “So Retaker’s killing time instead of burning the midnight oil.”

lines.japanese: 「鳳、その呼び方やめれー？」
lines.english: “Ohtori, would you quit calling me that?”

lines.japanese: 「そしてふたりは水と油！」
lines.english: “And you two mix like oil and water!”

lines.japanese: カケルくんと紀奈子さんは同い年。年下の俺はやんわりと仲裁に入ります。
lines.english: Kakeru and Kinako are the same age. I'm the younger one, so I gently step in to play peacemaker.

lines.japanese: 「そうだぞカケルくん、紀奈子さんはもうすぐ浪人生を卒業されるのだ。間違いないのだ。なにしろ受験戦争まで残すところ二ヵ月というこの時期に、アルバイトなんかしちゃうぐらい余裕なのだ」
lines.english: “That's right, Kakeru. Kinako will soon graduate from being a Retaker. Of this there can be no doubt. Why, with only two months remaining before the great war of entrance exams, she has enough leisure to hold down a part-time job.”

lines.japanese: 「余裕じゃないのだ。しかし、ふところも余裕じゃないから仕方ないのだ」
lines.english: “I'm not taking it easy. But my wallet isn't exactly flush either, so what choice do I have?”

lines.japanese: 「ううっ、ままならないのだ……」
lines.english: “Ugh. Nothing ever goes the way you want...”

lines.japanese: 「でも浪人、親から仕送りもらってんでしょ。遊ぶヒマもない受験生が、これ以上なんに使うの」
lines.english: “But Retaker, your parents send you money, right? What else do you need it for when you’re studying for exams and don’t even have time to have fun?”

lines.japanese: 「受験生だから使うんだよ、受験料」
lines.english: “Because I’m taking exams. Application fees.”

lines.japanese: 「受験料……って、え、親御さん出してくんないんすか」
lines.english: “Application fees...? Your parents won’t pay them?”

lines.japanese: 「うちの両親、もともと娘の進学もひとり暮らしも本意じゃないからね。せめて受験料ぐらいは自分で出したいんさ」
lines.english: “My parents never wanted their daughter to continue her education or live alone in the first place. I want to pay at least the application fees myself.”

lines.japanese: 「ええ話や。紀奈子はホンマ親孝行やで」
lines.english: Now that's a sweet story. Kinako's a good daughter, sure enough.

lines.japanese: 「二浪もしてる時点で親不幸じゃん」
lines.english: “Having to retake entrance exams twice is already rough on your parents.”

lines.japanese: 「鳳、ツッコミ冷たいぞ？」
lines.english: “Ouch, Ohtori. That was cold.”

lines.japanese: 「つーかさ、受験料稼ぐために受験落ちたら本末転倒じゃん？」
lines.english: “Besides, if working to earn the application fee makes you fail the exam, doesn’t that defeat the whole point?”

lines.japanese: 「うん。だからバイトは今月いっぱいでおしまい。引きこもって、がりがりガリ勉するさ」
lines.english: “Yes. That's why I'm quitting at the end of this month. I'll shut myself away and grind, grind, grind at my studies.”

lines.japanese: 「え、ガリガリするんすか」
lines.english: “You’ll grind and grind?”

lines.japanese: 「うん。ガリガリするよ」
lines.english: “Yes. Grind and grind.”

lines.japanese: 「もうガリガリ＆ベンベンっすか」
lines.english: “All work and no play makes Kinako a dull boy, huh?”

lines.japanese: 「ベンベンはしないかな。女の子だから」
lines.english: “Not a boy. I’m a girl.”

lines.japanese: 「え、でも……そしたら俺ら、もう紀奈子さんに会えなくなっちゃうってことすか！？」
lines.english: “But... then does that mean we won’t be able to see you anymore?”

lines.japanese: 「サクラ咲いたら戻ってくるつもりだけどね」
lines.english: “I’m planning to come back once I’ve passed my exams, though.”

lines.japanese: 「うむ。待っているぞ望月君。夜中に君の制服の香りをくんかくんか嗅ぎながら待っているぞ」
lines.english: “Indeed. We shall await you, Mochizuki. Late at night, I shall wait, snuffle-snuffling the fragrance of your uniform.”

lines.japanese: 「マスターたいへん！　それ冗談のつもりだと思うんですけど、アナタが言ったら犯罪予告！」
lines.english: Boss, we got a problem! I know that's supposed to be a joke, but when you say it, it's basically a threat to commit a crime!

lines.japanese: 「あ、すみません店長、これから忙しい時期なのにお休みいただいちゃって」
lines.english: “I’m sorry, Manager. I know this is your busy season, and I’m taking all that time off.”

lines.japanese: 「いやあ、気に病むことはないぞ望月君。君の受験休みはすでにアレキサンダー冬の風物詩だ。慣れた慣れた、はっはっはっはー」
lines.english: “Think nothing of it, Mochizuki. Your examination leave is already one of Alexander's annual winter traditions. We're accustomed to it! Ha ha ha ha!”

lines.japanese: 「マスターたいへん！　いまアナタ、無邪気に言葉の刃を振りまわしてます！」
lines.english: “Boss, emergency! You’re innocently swinging a blade made of words!”

lines.japanese: 「……いいもん。浪人ネタでいじられるのも今年で最後だから」
lines.english: “...Fine. This is the last year anyone gets to tease me for being a Retaker.”

lines.japanese: 「うむ、その意気だ望月君。あー、そこでだ。いまちょうど三人で話しあっていたのだが、このたび盛大に君の壮行会を開こうと思う」
lines.english: “That is the spirit, Mochizuki. Which brings me to the matter at hand. The three of us were just discussing a grand send-off in your honor.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「あ……いや、それだ！　合コンあらため紀奈子さんの壮行会！」
lines.english: “Oh... yes, that’s it! Forget the group date—we’re holding Kinako’s send-off!”

lines.japanese: 「素晴らしい、さすがマスター！　ナイス機転、驚きのリニューアル！　大人の事情であっさり誌名が変わる成年コミック業界のようです！　壮行会！　紀奈子さんの壮行会！　これなら彼女も断れないはず！」
lines.english: “Genius! That’s our boss! Quick thinking, a dazzling rebrand! Just like an adult comics magazine changing its name overnight for... adult reasons! A send-off! Kinako’s send-off! She can’t possibly turn that down!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いいですいいです。あんまり応援されちゃうと恥ずかしいし、かえってプレッシャーになるんで」
lines.english: “No, thank you. If everyone makes that much of a fuss, I'll only be embarrassed. It'd put even more pressure on me.”

lines.japanese: 「策士、策に溺れる！」
lines.english: “The schemer outsmarted himself!”

lines.japanese: 「いや違う、うそうそ！　壮行会、大うそ！　いまの間違いっす、ただの合コンっす！　あの不精ヒゲ、国語の成績あんまり良くなかったから許してあげよう！　だからもう、ふるってご参加ください！」
lines.english: “No, wait, we lied! The send-off was a great big lie! We misspoke—it’s only a group date! Forgive that unshaven brute; he never did very well in Japanese class. So please, do honor us with your eager participation!”

lines.japanese: 「いいっすよね、出席っすよね、お友達を多数お誘いのうえお越しくださいますよね！」
lines.english: “You’ll attend, won’t you? And bring a great many friends with you, won’t you?”

lines.japanese: 「横ぴぃ──す☆」
lines.english: “Peace! But sideways! ☆”

lines.japanese: 「お願い、聞いて！　謎のポージングとかいいから！」
lines.english: “Please, listen! Forget the weird pose!”

lines.japanese: 「聞いてたけどー、だって合コンでしょ。私、いまそんな余裕ないもん」
lines.english: “I was listening. It’s a group date, right? I don’t have time for that now.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、合コンじゃないよ、合コンごっこ。ねえ、シュウちゃん」
lines.english: “Oh, it isn't a group date. They're only playing at having one. Isn't that right, Shu?”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん……まぁ……」
lines.english: “Y-yes... more or less...”

lines.japanese: 「千歳君……なんで目を逸らして曖昧に微笑んでるの？」
lines.english: “Chitose... why are you avoiding my eyes and smiling vaguely?”

lines.japanese: 「いえ……自分、Ｊボーイですから」
lines.english: “Well... I’m a Japanese guy.”

lines.japanese: 「つーかマスター、浪人でいいの？　なんか雷とか砂浜とか、ゴチャゴチャわけ分かんない審査基準あったじゃん」
lines.english: “But boss, are you okay with Retaker? Weren't there all those incomprehensible requirements about thunder and beaches?”

lines.japanese: 「おいおいカケルよ。下はふにゃふにゃのくせに、口だけはずいぶん硬いことを言うやつだな」
lines.english: “Come now, Kakeru. For a man so limp below the waist, you speak remarkably stiff words.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、言ってたのアンタ」
lines.english: “You were the one who said them.”

lines.japanese: 「まぁまぁ、いいでしょう。それなら、とりあえず審査させていただきましょう──あのう、紀奈子さん？」
lines.english: “Now, now. Very well. Let us perform the examination. Um, Kinako?”

lines.japanese: 「んー、なんだい？」
lines.english: “Hmm? What is it?”

lines.japanese: 「突然ですけど、紀奈子さんは雷とかって恐いですか？」
lines.english: This is kinda out of nowhere, but, Kinako, are you scared of thunder?

lines.japanese: 「かみなり？」
lines.english: “Thunder?”

lines.japanese: 「えー、なんでー？　恐いわけないよ、うちの田舎、雷様が多くて有名なとこだもん。子供のころなんてもう、空が光るたび、キャッキャ言って庭に飛びだしてたさ」
lines.english: “Why would I be? My hometown is famous for its thunderstorms. When I was little, every flash in the sky sent me squealing happily out into the yard.”

lines.japanese: 「ほら、駄目じゃん」
lines.english: “See? Disqualified.”

lines.japanese: 「いいや合格！　それはそれでなんか可愛いから合格！」
lines.english: “No, she passes! That’s adorable in its own way, so she passes!”
“...What?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あの、よく分かんないけど失格でいいよ？　なんか嫌な予感するし。うん、そう、カミナリ天敵。このまえ雷おこし食べてて顎がカクッてなったし」
lines.english: “I don’t really understand, but I’m happy to be disqualified. This feels ominous. Yes, thunder is my mortal enemy. The other day I was eating one of those sweet ‘thunder’ rice crackers and my jaw went click.”

lines.japanese: 「可愛い！　火に油をそそいで首席合格！」
lines.english: “Adorable! You've poured oil on the fire and passed with top marks!”

lines.japanese: 「というわけだ。望月君、明日は店舗貸切として閉店を２時間早め、午後８時より君の特別壮行会をおこなう。異存はあるか。いや、ないに違いない」
lines.english: “There we have it. Mochizuki, tomorrow Alexander will close two hours early for a private function, and at eight o’clock we shall hold your special send-off. Any objections? No, surely there are none.”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ？　え？　えーっと……」
lines.english: “What? Wait, um...”

lines.japanese: 「うむ、ないようだな」
lines.english: “Excellent. None at all.”

lines.japanese: 「そう……ですね……はい、分かりました。やっぱり楽しそうだからいいです。うん。頭を受験モードに切りかえる区切りにもなりそうだしね」
lines.english: “I... suppose not. All right. It does sound fun after all. And it might make a good dividing line before I switch my brain into exam mode.”

lines.japanese: 「素晴らしい！　さすが紀奈子さん、大人の女！　人生の楽しみ方が分かってる！」
lines.english: “Magnificent! I knew we could count on you, Kinako—a woman of the world! You know how to enjoy life!”

lines.japanese: 「へへー、伊達に二浪はしてないぜー」
lines.english: “Heh heh. I haven't spent two whole years retaking exams for nothing.”

lines.japanese: 「二浪ってゆーなー！」
lines.english: “Stop saying I've been at it for two years!”

lines.japanese: 「おお、自虐的ノリツッコミ。紀奈子さん、いいテンションっす」
lines.english: “Oh, you set yourself up and shot yourself down! You’re in fine form, Kinako.”

lines.japanese: 「浪人、朱に交わってると三浪するよ」
lines.english: “Retaker, keep running with this crowd and you'll be in for year three.”
“Urgh...”

lines.japanese: 「カケルくん、憶測でものを言うのはよくない」
lines.english: “Kakeru, you shouldn’t speculate without evidence.”

lines.japanese: 「ん。いぐね、いぐね」
lines.english: “Mm. Not good, not good.”

lines.japanese: 「憶測ってか見たまんまじゃん」
lines.english: “It isn’t speculation. I’m looking right at the evidence.”

lines.japanese: 「いやいや。紀奈子さんはどんなに涼しい顔をしていても、水の下では必死に足を掻いてるタイプなのだ」
lines.english: “Now, now. However serene Kinako may look, she's the type who paddles desperately beneath the water.”

lines.japanese: 「ん、分がってる。鷲介はよう分がってる」
lines.english: “Mm. You unnerstan’. Shusuke unnerstan’ real good.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃ二年前から掻いとけよ」
lines.english: “Then she should’ve started paddling two years ago.”

lines.japanese: 「ん、もっともな話だ」
lines.english: “Mm. A compelling point.”

lines.japanese: そして紀奈子さんは、渋面でしみじみ頷きながら仕事に戻るのでした。
lines.english: And with that, Kinako went back to work, nodding thoughtfully with a sour look on her face.

lines.japanese: 「いやあ、やりましたねマスター」
lines.english: “We did it, boss.”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 「ふふ、そこの小生意気なやさ男に頭を下げずとも、我々の猿知恵だけでまんまとギャル一名確保ですよ。スポ根漫画でいえば、最初の仲間が加わってちょっと面白くなってきたところですよ」
lines.english: Heh heh. And without bowing our heads to that cheeky pretty boy, we managed to snag ourselves one whole girl with nothing but our monkey brains. If this were a sports manga, this is where the first teammate joins and things finally start getting fun.

lines.japanese: 「いや、慢心するな鷲介。部員集めに話数を割くのも結構だが、さっさと試合を始めねばいまの読者はすぐに飽きてしまうぞ」
lines.english: “Do not grow complacent, Shusuke. Spending chapters recruiting the team is all very well, but unless the match begins soon, today's readers will lose interest.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そーすね、十週打ち切りだけは避けたいとこっす。さて、これで男３に女１だから……」
lines.english: “Oh, right. We definitely don’t want to get canceled after ten weeks. So now we’ve got three guys and one girl…”

lines.japanese: 「だから違うってシュウちゃん。男２でしょ」
lines.english: “Wrong again, Shu. Two men.”

lines.japanese: 「男２！？　え、マスター降りるんすか？」
lines.english: “Two? Boss, are you dropping out?”

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿を言うな。部長の俺が甲子園の夢を諦めてどうする。なあ、カケル」
lines.english: “Don't be an idiot. How can I, the captain, abandon our dream of reaching Koshien? Isn't that right, Kakeru?”

lines.japanese: 「知らないって。俺、ハナから部員じゃないもん」
lines.english: “How would I know? I was never on the team.”

lines.japanese: 「チーム内に不和！」
lines.english: “Dissension in the ranks!”

lines.japanese: 「待て。エースで４番のカケルを手放すわけにはいかん。辞めるならライパチのおまえが辞めろ、鷲介」
lines.english: “Wait. We cannot release Kakeru, our ace pitcher and cleanup hitter. If someone must leave, it will be you, Shusuke—right field, batting eighth.”

lines.japanese: 「そして主人公に訪れる危機！」
lines.english: “And now, a crisis befalls our hero!”

lines.japanese: 「おっはよーカケルぅ！」
lines.english: “Morning, Kakeru!”

lines.japanese: 「そのとき、闇の中から恐るべき異形の影が！」
lines.english: “And then, from the darkness, a hideous and terrifying shadow!”

lines.japanese: 「てめ誰が暗黒大魔王だコノヤロ」
lines.english: “Who the hell are you calling the Dark Lord, asshole?”

lines.japanese: 「いい痛い痛い痛い！　英里子さん、シルバートレイの顔面プレスは見た目に反して意外に痛い！」
lines.english: “Ow-ow-ow! Eriko, pressing a silver tray into my face hurts a lot more than you'd think!”

lines.japanese: さて女子大生の日野英里子さんは、ご覧のとおり、一見ノリの良い活力に満ちあふれたお姉さんです。
lines.english: Now, as you can see, university student Eriko Hino appears at first glance to be a lively young woman, overflowing with cheerful energy.

lines.japanese: 「千歳さー、コーヒー一杯で粘ってないで早く帰れってー」
lines.english: “Chitose, quit nursing one cup of coffee and go home already.”

lines.japanese: しかしてその実体は、口も荒いが気も荒い、やりたい放題の自由人です。
lines.english: Her true nature, however, is a foul-mouthed, hot-tempered free spirit who does whatever she pleases.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあシュウちゃん、うるさいの来たからそろそろ出よっか」
lines.english: “Well, Shu, the noisy one is here. Want to get going?”

lines.japanese: 「やぁ～ん、カケルはいいのよぉ、パスタセットなんだしぃ」
lines.english: Aww, Kakeru's fiiine—he got the pasta set and all.
“Wait...!”

lines.japanese: 「な、なんすか、いきなりその吹き替え洋画のお色気シーンみたいな桃色ボイスは！　この店は頼んだ品の値段によって対応が違うんすか！」
lines.english: “Wh-what’s with that sexy voice, like something out of a steamy scene in a dubbed foreign movie?! Does this place treat customers differently depending on how expensive their order is?!”

lines.japanese: 「ちげえよ。メニューじゃなくて客で差別してんの」
lines.english: “No. We discriminate by customer, not menu item.”

lines.japanese: 「ぃやっほう！」
lines.english: “Yee-haw!”

lines.japanese: 嘘がつけない英里子さんに、思わずスツールを３回転させて華麗なスピンターンを決める俺。
lines.english: Overcome by Eriko’s inability to lie, I spun my stool through three full revolutions and executed a magnificent turn.
“Magnificent!”

lines.japanese: 「素晴らしい、さすが英里子さん！　自分を偽らない！　客観を廃して主観を信じる眼、そしてそれを主張できる強靭な精神力！　まさにいまを生きぬく現代女性の鑑っすね！」
lines.english: “Magnificent! I knew we could count on you, Eriko! You refuse to betray yourself! Eyes that reject objectivity and trust their own judgment, joined to the strength of spirit to proclaim it! You are a paragon of the modern woman surviving in the world today!”

lines.japanese: 「いや、鷲介のそういう前向き思考もなかなかだと思うぞ」
lines.english: “That relentless optimism of yours is rather impressive too, Shusuke.”

lines.japanese: 「ねーホント、千歳っていい性格してるよねー」
lines.english: “Seriously, Chitose. You have quite the personality.”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、英里子さんほどでは」
lines.english: “Not as bad as you, Eriko.”

lines.japanese: 「つかヒノエリ、声大きいと馬鹿バレるからボリューム絞れば？」
lines.english: “Hinoeri, turn down the volume. People will figure out you're stupid.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょ……ちょっと千歳、いまの聞いた？　カケルひどくなーい？」
lines.english: “H-hey, Chitose, did you hear that? Wasn’t that awful of Kakeru?”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、英里子さんほどでは」
lines.english: “Not as bad as you, Eriko.”

lines.japanese: 「おい鷲介、どうする。今度の候補者はこの有様だが、オーディションの必要性はあるか」
lines.english: “What do you think, Shusuke? This is the state of our next candidate. Is an audition even necessary?”

lines.japanese: 「ハイ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「まー、そおっすねえー。露骨に仲間外れは可愛そうだし？　まー、テキトーに誘うだけ誘ってあげたら角も立たな──」
lines.english: Weeell, yeeah, I guess. It'd be kinda mean to leave her out that obviously, right? Maybe just toss her an invite or something, keep things from getting awk—

lines.japanese: 「──痛い痛い痛い！　英里子さん、立てたトレイは倍痛い！」
lines.english: “Ow-ow-ow! Eriko, the tray hurts twice as much when you use the edge!”

lines.japanese: 「てめ、なんか知らねーけど、いま私のこと高い位置から見下ろしただろ、あ？」
lines.english: “I don’t know what the hell this is about, but you were just looking down your nose at me, weren’t you? Huh?”
“Eeeek!”

lines.japanese: 「こら、やめなさい日野君。いくら相手が鷲介といえど、お客様に手を上げるのは──」
lines.english: “Now, stop that, Hino. Even if the customer is Shusuke, striking him is—”

lines.japanese: 「なんすか」
lines.english: “Is what?”

lines.japanese: 「──とくに問題ないと思います」
lines.english: “—not an issue of particular concern.”

lines.japanese: 「子供を叱れない大人！」
lines.english: “An adult incapable of disciplining the young!”

lines.japanese: 「だから、ヒノエリうるさいって。死ねよ。死ね死ね死ね死ね死ね死ね」
lines.english: “Hinoeri, I told you, you're too loud. Die. Die, die, die, die, die, die.”

lines.japanese: 「やだぁ、うるさいのは私じゃないでしょーもー、カケルってばイケズぅ」
lines.english: “Oh, don’t be silly. I’m not the noisy one. Kakeru, you’re so mean.”

lines.japanese: 「ふう……英里子さんがくねくねとガラにもなくシナを作ってくれたおかげで命拾いしたっす……」
lines.english: “Phew... Eriko’s bizarre decision to writhe around and act coquettish has saved my life...”

lines.japanese: 「で？　なんの話？　誘うとか誘わないとか」
lines.english: “So? What are you talking about? Inviting somebody somewhere?”

lines.japanese: 「あーハイちょいとお尋ねしますがぁー」
lines.english: “Ah, yes. Just one little question for you...”

lines.japanese: 「……おまえ、なんでそんなテンションだだ下がりなんだよ」
lines.english: “Why did your energy suddenly fall through the floor?”

lines.japanese: 「英里子さんはー、雷とかってどう思いますー？」
lines.english: “Eriko, what do you think about thunder?”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　なに？　かみなり？」
lines.english: “What? Thunder?”

lines.japanese: 「や、だからこう、女の子でいるじゃないすか。空がピガゴローッて鳴ると、思わずおへそを隠して『きゃっ』とか言っちゃう」
lines.english: “You know the kind of girl I mean. The sky goes flash-ka-boom, and she instinctively covers her belly button and squeaks.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだそりゃ。空想上の生物か」
lines.english: “What the hell is that? A mythical creature?”

lines.japanese: 「ばっ！　なに言ってんですかアナタ、バリバリ実存しますよ！　穢れてる英里子さんが知らないだけで！」
lines.english: Buh! What are you talking about? They totally exist! You just don't know any because you're filthy, Eriko!

lines.japanese: 「だーはっはっはっはっはっはっは！」
lines.english: “Dahahahahahahaha!”

lines.japanese: 「いねーいねーぜってーいねー！　いまどきそんなんいるわきゃねー！」
lines.english: They don't, they don't, they damn well don't! Nobody like that exists anymore!

lines.japanese: 「い、いるもんっ！　ボクらの夢の中には、男の半裸姿を見て頬を赤らめちゃう女の子とか、ゴキブリに遭遇したら思わず抱きついてきちゃう女の子とか、いっぱいいっぱい生きつづけているんだもんっ！」
lines.english: “They do so! In our dreams, countless girls still live on—girls who blush at the sight of a man with his shirt off, girls who leap into our arms when they see a cockroach, and so many more!”

lines.japanese: 「あ──っひゃっひゃっひゃっひゃっ！！」
lines.english: “Ah-hyah-hyah-hyah-hyah!”

lines.japanese: 「笑うなよう！　手を叩いて笑うなよう！」
lines.english: “Don’t laugh! And stop clapping while you do it!”

lines.japanese: 「バァーカ。バァァ──カ」
lines.english: “Idiot. Id-i-ot.”

lines.japanese: 「指を差して真顔で迫るなよう！」
lines.english: “Don’t come at me all straight-faced, pointing like that!”

lines.japanese: 「……ふむ、不採用だな。残念ながら今回は縁がなかったということでお引き取り願おう」
lines.english: “Hmm. Rejected. Regrettably, it appears we were not destined to work together on this occasion. You may leave.”

lines.japanese: 「え？　なにがよ？　だから私、なんの話だって聞いてんじゃん。いいから質問に答えてよ」
lines.english: “What? Why? I keep asking what you’re talking about. Just answer the question.”

lines.japanese: 「合コンごっこの話だってさ」
lines.english: “It’s about a pretend group date, apparently.”

lines.japanese: 「合コン！？　うそ、行く行く！　えっ、マジ、久しぶりじゃん！」
lines.english: “A group date? Seriously? I’m in! I’m in! God, it’s been forever!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あら？　意外……ソッコー断られると思ったけど、けっこう喰いつきいいんすね」
lines.english: “Oh? That’s unexpected... I thought you’d turn us down right away, but you really took the bait.”

lines.japanese: 「当ったりまえじゃん、私を誰だと思ってんの」
lines.english: “Obviously. Who do you think I am?”

lines.japanese: 「え、誰なんすか」
lines.english: “Who are you?”

lines.japanese: 「ふっ……学校のサークル仲間からは、コンパ潰しのエリーと呼ばれていてよ」
lines.english: Hmph... My college club knows me as Ellie the Party Slayer, if you please.

lines.japanese: 「いや、潰すなよ」
lines.english: “You’re not supposed to kill the party.”

lines.japanese: 「で、で、相手は！？　医者？　弁護士？　ゲーノー人？」
lines.english: “So who are the men? Doctors? Lawyers? Celebrities?”

lines.japanese: 「愛多き飲食業」
lines.english: “A restaurant man with love to spare.”

lines.japanese: 「夢見るフリーター」
lines.english: “A part-timer with a dream.”

lines.japanese: 「以上２名がエスコートいたします」
lines.english: “Those are the two gentlemen who will escort you.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、ごめ、そういえばウチ門限チョー厳しいんだった」
lines.english: “Oh, sorry. I just remembered I have a super-strict curfew.”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ！　アナタ、しょっちゅう外泊してるのに！」
lines.english: “What?! You spend the night out all the time!”

lines.japanese: 「金もないしねー。私もいろいろ大変じゃん？　ほら、ひとり暮らしだからー」
lines.english: “And I’m broke. I have a lot on my plate too, you know. Living all by myself and everything.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃ門限関係ないじゃん！　アナタいま、気持ちいいぐらい語るに落ちてますよ！」
lines.english: Then your curfew has nothing to do with it! You just gave yourself away so hard it was almost satisfying!

lines.japanese: 「やー、だって……ねえ？」
lines.english: “Well, yes, but... you know?”

lines.japanese: 「オトコが店長と千歳でしょー。せめてカケルが来んならいいけどさー」
lines.english: “The men are the Manager and Chitose. I might consider it if Kakeru were coming, at least.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　てめ、せめてとか言ってんじゃねーぞクソが」
lines.english: “The hell? Don't you 'at least' me, you piece of shit.”

lines.japanese: 「うわあ、現代社会の病巣・キレやすい若者！」
lines.english: “Behold, the festering wound of modern society: the hair-trigger youth!”

lines.japanese: 「死ねよ、腐れマ××」
lines.english: “Die, you rotten c***.”

lines.japanese: 「そして氾濫する過激な性表現！」
lines.english: “And behold, the flood of explicit sexual language!”

lines.japanese: 「──なんだけどぉ、なんか私ィ、最近カケルに虐げられるのが心地いいような気ィしててぇ」
lines.english: —but latelyyy, I kinda feel like I'm starting to enjoy Kakeru walking all over meee.

lines.japanese: 「マスターたいへん！　救急車二台！」
lines.english: “Boss, emergency! Two ambulances!”

lines.japanese: 「おっ、なんだ鷲介、夜も更けないうちから出張イメクラ看護婦コースか」
lines.english: “What’s this, Shusuke? Ordering a naughty-nurse house call already? It’s not even late.”

lines.japanese: 「やっぱ三台！」
lines.english: “Make that three!”

lines.japanese: アレキサンダー花水木通り店は、今日も自由なひとがいっぱいです。
lines.english: Another day at Alexander's Flowering Dogwood Street branch, another restaurant full of free spirits.

lines.japanese: 「店長すいませーん、４番さんアールグレイ入りましたー」
lines.english: “Manager, sorry—table four ordered an Earl Grey.”

lines.japanese: 「む、了解だ」
lines.english: “Mm. Understood.”

lines.japanese: ま、キングオブ自由なひとの狩男さんも、さすがにお仕事だけは真面目にこなしますけどね。
lines.english: Of course, even Karuo, king of all free spirits, treated the actual work seriously.

lines.japanese: 英里子さんもまた持ち場に戻ろうとして──
lines.english: Eriko started back toward her station too—

lines.japanese: 「んー、でもそーいやー、しばらく飲んでなかったなぁ」
lines.english: “Hmm. Come to think of it, I haven’t been out drinking in a while.”

lines.japanese: ──だけど、ふと立ちどまって振りかえりました。
lines.english: —but stopped suddenly and looked back.

lines.japanese: 「まあ、そりゃあねえ。クラッシャーとして悪名を馳せるようじゃ、呼ばれなくもなりますよねえ」
lines.english: “Well, naturally. Once you become infamous as a party destroyer, invitations tend to dry up.”

lines.japanese: 「千歳、その合コンごっこ、いつよ？　すーんげ暇だったら、ちょっとぐらいカオ出してやってもいいけど」
lines.english: Chitose, when's this pretend mixer thing? If I'm, like, insanely bored, I might grace you with my presence for a bit.

lines.japanese: 「えっ！　なんでそんな無駄に偉そうなのか理解しかねるけど、マジっすか！」
lines.english: What?! I have no idea why you're acting so pointlessly high-and-mighty, but seriously?!

lines.japanese: 「明日午後８時より、当店貸切にておこなう予定だ」
lines.english: “Tomorrow at eight in the evening. We intend to close the restaurant for a private function.”

lines.japanese: 紅茶の準備を始めていたマスターが、すかさず声を投げてよこしました。
lines.english: The boss, already preparing the tea, tossed the answer over immediately.

lines.japanese: 「ふーん、明日ね」
lines.english: “Tomorrow, huh?”

lines.japanese: 「ん……だったらオッケ。行ける行ける」
lines.english: “Hmm... All right, then. I can make it.”

lines.japanese: 「土曜の夜が暇っつーことは、ヒノエリつねに暇ってことじゃん」
lines.english: “If you're free on Saturday night, Hinoeri, doesn't that mean you're always free?”

lines.japanese: 「きゃーん、カミナリこわーい、ゴキブリこわーい」
lines.english: “Eeeek, thunder! Eeeek, cockroaches!”

lines.japanese: 英里子さんは乙女ちっくに身をくねらせながら、そそくさと仕事に戻っていきました。
lines.english: Eriko gave a coy little squirm, playing the delicate girl, then hurried back to work.

lines.japanese: マスターが俺に向かって、ぐっと親指を突きたてます。同じアクションで応えつつふと左を向けば、カケルくんが新しい煙草に火を点けていました。
lines.english: The boss thrust a triumphant thumb in my direction. I returned the gesture, then glanced left to find Kakeru lighting a fresh cigarette.

lines.japanese: 「シュウちゃんいいの？　アレ、審査基準に程遠いじゃん」
lines.english: “Are you sure about this, Shu? She isn’t remotely close to the criteria.”

lines.japanese: 「審査員特別賞です。あの容赦ないアグレッシヴさに心を打たれました」
lines.english: “The Judges' Special Prize. We were moved by her merciless aggression.”

lines.japanese: 「つか、誰でもいいわけ？」
lines.english: “So literally anyone will do?”

lines.japanese: 「ま、楽しけりゃね」
lines.english: “As long as we have fun.”

lines.japanese: 「ふーん」
lines.english: “Huh.”

lines.japanese: カケルくんは前髪の下から覗く冷めた目をいったん俺に向け、また正面に戻しました。
lines.english: Kakeru turned the jaded eyes beneath his bangs toward me for a moment, then faced forward again.

lines.japanese: 「シュウちゃんって、ほんと暑苦しい慣れ合い好きだよね」
lines.english: “Shu, you really do love all this overheated, buddy-buddy bonding.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、そーね」
lines.english: “Yeah, guess I do.”

lines.japanese: 俺たちは視線を合わせず、マスターの意外にマスターっぽい背中を見るともなしに見つめていました。
lines.english: Without looking at each other, we stared vaguely at the boss’s back. He looked, surprisingly, like the man in charge.

lines.japanese: ティーポットから布フィルターを引きあげても、赤いしずくを零さない見事な手際。さすが腐ってもアレキサンダー一国一城のあるじです。
lines.english: He lifted the cloth filter from the teapot without spilling a single red drop. Whatever else one might say, he was lord of his own little kingdom at Alexander.

lines.japanese: 「で。カケルくんも来てくれるんでしょ」
lines.english: “So. You’re coming too, Kakeru?”

lines.japanese: さりげなく聞いてみると、彼は俺の反対側に細い煙を噴きだして、回答をワンテンポずらしてきました。
lines.english: I let the question sound casual. He blew a thin stream of smoke away from me, delaying his answer by a beat.

lines.japanese: 「つったって、もう２対２で面子揃ってんじゃん。俺いらなくない？」
lines.english: “But you already have two men and two women. You don’t need me, do you?”

lines.japanese: 「鷲介、この調子なら、女子もう一名ぐらい俺の方で確保できそうだぞ」
lines.english: Shusuke, looks like I can probably round up one more girl on my end.

lines.japanese: 「──だって」
lines.english: “You heard him.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな、無理に人数増やさなくったって」
lines.english: “You don’t have to go out of your way to find more people.”

lines.japanese: 「いやあ、人数多い方が楽しいでしょう」
lines.english: “More people means more fun.”

lines.japanese: 「俺入ったら、むしろ場の空気悪くなると思うけど？」
lines.english: If I join, won't I just kill the mood?

lines.japanese: 「そんなことないでしょー。俺は好きだけどなー、カケルくんの氷のツッコミ」
lines.english: Nah, c'mon. I kinda like those ice-cold comebacks of yours, Kakeru.

lines.japanese: 「ああ、それとも？　土曜の夜だから野暮用でもあるのかしら？」
lines.english: “Unless you have some pressing engagement? It is Saturday night, after all.”

lines.japanese: 「べつに。大した予定じゃないけど」
lines.english: “Not really. Nothing important.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ来てくれるよねえ」
lines.english: “Then you’ll come.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、まあ、どうでもいいけ……」
lines.english: “Fine. Whatever. I don’t—”

lines.japanese: 「マスター、カケルくんゲットー！」
lines.english: “Boss, we got Kakeru!”

lines.japanese: マスターは作業を続けながら、俺ではなく、俺の隣りの無愛想な若者に向かって大きく一回頷きました。
lines.english: Without pausing in his work, the boss gave one emphatic nod, directed past me to the sullen young man at my side.

lines.japanese: カケルくんは視線から逃げるように壁時計を確認すると、鼻から煙を噴きだして、半分以上残っていた煙草を灰皿の上で押しつぶしました。
lines.english: As if to escape his gaze, Kakeru checked the clock on the wall, blew smoke through his nose, and crushed his cigarette into the ashtray with more than half of it still left.

lines.japanese: 「俺、このあと予定あるから帰るわ」
lines.english: “I have somewhere to be, so I’m leaving.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そーなの？」
lines.english: “Oh, you do?”

lines.japanese: カウンターテーブルの上の原稿用紙を、クリアファイルに戻して突きだすカケルくん。俺はそれを受けとりながら尋ねました。
lines.english: He slid my manuscript pages back into their clear folder and pushed them across the counter. I took them and asked—

lines.japanese: 「今回の原稿どうだった？　直した方がいいとことかあった？」
lines.english: “What did you think of this one? Anything I should fix?”

lines.japanese: 「べつに。いいんじゃない」
lines.english: “Not really. It’s fine.”

lines.japanese: 彼は興味なさそうに言って席を立つと、ユルめのジャケットに袖を通します。それは日本人離れしたスマートな長身に難なくハマりました。
lines.english: He rose with an air of total disinterest and slipped into a loose-fitting jacket. It settled effortlessly over his tall, elegant frame, uncommon among Japanese men.

lines.japanese: 「シュウちゃん、明日ヨネんとこ何時ごろ行くの？」
lines.english: “Shu, what time are you going to Yone’s tomorrow?”

lines.japanese: ヨネこと米田優さんは、カケルくんに紹介してもらった『メンズフリーズ』の編集さん。ちなみに２０代ギリ前半の素敵な女性。
lines.english: Yone—Yu Yoneda—is an editor at Men's Freeze who Kakeru introduced me to. And, for the record, she's a lovely woman who's just barely still in her early twenties.

lines.japanese: カケルくんがカット描きとしてお世話になってるその月刊誌で、実は俺も、家で出来るちょっとした内職をさせてもらっているのです。
lines.english: Kakeru contributed spot illustrations to the monthly magazine, and, as it happened, they had also given me a little work I could do on the side, from home.

lines.japanese: 「米田さんには３時ごろ行くって言ってあるけど」
lines.english: “I told Yoneda I’d be there around three.”

lines.japanese: 「そ。時間あったら俺も行くと思う」
lines.english: “Right. If I have time, I might come too.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そーなん？」
lines.english: “Oh. Really?”

lines.japanese: 返事はありません。彼はうつむいて表情を隠したまま、椅子の上に置いたバッグから財布を抜きだしました。
lines.english: No answer. He kept his head lowered, hiding his face, and took his wallet from the bag on his chair.

lines.japanese: 「……え、それはなんか、カケルくんが編集部に用事とかあって？」
lines.english: “...Do you have business at the editorial office or something?”

lines.japanese: 「べつに。なんとなく」
lines.english: “No. Just felt like it.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、そう……」
lines.english: “Oh. I see...”

lines.japanese: カケルくんは基本的に病的なぐらい無愛想な男の子ですが、ときどき、主人によくなついた猟犬みたいな一面を覗かせたりします。
lines.english: Kakeru was pathologically aloof at the best of times, but every now and then he showed the nature of a hunting dog deeply attached to its master.

lines.japanese: 俺なんかに付きまとわなくても、いくらだって女の子が寄ってくるのにねえ。
lines.english: There were any number of girls ready to trail after him. He hardly needed to trail after me.

lines.japanese: ま、老若男女の別なく、誰であれ誰かに親しみを持たれるっていうのは、そりゃあとっても有難いことなんですけど。
lines.english: Well, young or old, guy or girl, having anybody warm up to you is something to be really grateful for.

lines.japanese: 「じゃこれ、シュウちゃん会計よろしく。釣りは明日ちょうだい」
lines.english: “Here, Shu. Take care of my bill. Give me the change tomorrow.”

lines.japanese: そしてカケルくんは、千円札を二枚置いてアレキサンダーを出ていきました。
lines.english: Kakeru left two 1,000-yen notes on the counter and walked out of Alexander.

lines.japanese: カウンター席にひとり残された俺は、しばらく有線放送から降りそそぐ日本語のウインターソングに耳を傾けて、冷めたコーヒーをちびちび啜っていました。
lines.english: Alone at the counter, I listened for a while to a Japanese winter song raining down from the cable radio and sipped at my cold coffee.

lines.japanese: 普段はオールディーズなアメリカンポップス＆ロックンロールが中心のアレキサンダー花水木通り店も、本部のご意向だとかで、来たる１２月に備えて小学生でも知ってる流行りのＪ－ＰＯＰを垂れながしています。
lines.english: Alexander's Flowering Dogwood Street branch ordinarily favored American pop oldies and rock and roll, but head office had apparently decreed that, with December approaching, we must pump out trendy J-pop songs even grade-schoolers knew.

lines.japanese: ミラーボールの下で人差し指を突きあげてる外人さんのレトロなポスターも、今月に入ってからは、中途半端な直径のクリスマスリーフになかば隠されていました。
lines.english: Even the retro poster of a foreign man pointing one finger skyward beneath a mirror ball had been half-hidden since the beginning of the month by a Christmas wreath of awkwardly middling diameter.

lines.japanese: 空になったカップを置いてなんとなく体を斜めに向けると、仲むつまじげに食事している男女の客が視界に入ってきます。
lines.english: I set down my empty cup and turned idly to one side, catching sight of a couple enjoying a cozy meal together.

lines.japanese: この季節になるとどこのカップルも浮かれているように見えてしまうのは、寂しいシングル男の被害妄想なんでしょうかね。
lines.english: Then again, maybe every couple just looks giddy this time of year because I'm a lonely single guy with a persecution complex.

lines.japanese: 下唇を突きだして、短い溜息を真上に向けて吹きつけてみました。ぶわっと前髪が揺れます。
lines.english: I pushed out my lower lip and blew a short sigh straight upward. My bangs fluttered.

lines.japanese: そうやって所在ない視線を程よく賑やかな店内にさまよわせていると、レジの後ろの張り紙が目に留まりました。
lines.english: As my aimless gaze wandered through the pleasantly busy restaurant, a notice behind the register caught my eye.

lines.japanese: 大っきな『急募』の二文字が、真っ赤なポップ体で自己主張しています。
lines.english: The enormous words HELP WANTED asserted themselves in bright red display type.

lines.japanese: 学生可。男女問わず。職種フロアスタッフ。時給８００円以上。勤務時間応相談。
lines.english: Students welcome. Men and women. Floor staff. From 800 yen an hour. Hours negotiable.

lines.japanese: 明日をも知れぬフリーアルバイターとしては、いちおう記憶に留めておいた方がいいかもしれません。
lines.english: As a free-floating part-timer who never knew what tomorrow might bring, I thought it prudent to remember that.

lines.japanese: 「マスター、あの募集……」
lines.english: “Boss, that opening...”

lines.japanese: 支店長に詳細を尋ねようとして、やめました。気が付けば、なにやら店内はお客さんが増えてきて忙しそうです。
lines.english: I nearly asked the branch manager for details, then stopped. Before I knew it, the restaurant had filled with customers, and everyone looked busy.

lines.japanese: 時刻は午後８時の１０分前。世間は楽しい夕餉のときみたいです。ええ、結構なことです。
lines.english: It was ten to eight. Looked like the respectable world was sitting down to a nice dinner. Yep. Good for them.

lines.japanese: そこに、やや急ぎ足で通りかかった英里子さん。
lines.english: Eriko passed at a brisk pace.

lines.japanese: 「あー、千歳まだいたの」
lines.english: “Oh. Chitose, you’re still here?”

lines.japanese: 「いたら邪魔みたいな口ぶりっすね」
lines.english: “You say that like I’m in the way.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、邪魔だろ」
lines.english: “No. You are in the way.”
“Yee-haw!”

lines.japanese: 後頭部を殴られたような衝撃は、せつなさでスピンして弾きとばします。
lines.english: It hit like a punch to the back of my head. I spun the shock away in a whirl of heartbreak.

lines.japanese: くるくるっと２回転終えて椅子が止まると、英里子さんは冷めた目で俺を見下ろしていました。
lines.english: After two complete revolutions, my stool came to rest. Eriko looked down at me with chilly eyes.

lines.japanese: 「だっておまえいると、店長とか紀奈子さんとか、面白がって無駄話するじゃん」
lines.english: “When you’re here, the Manager and Kinako and everyone start fooling around and wasting time because they think you’re funny.”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ、それ俺のせいなんすか。ていうか、英里子さんだっていま無駄話してるじゃないすか」
lines.english: “What? That’s my fault? Besides, you’re wasting time talking to me right now.”

lines.japanese: 「それなんだよ。ほら、千歳って暇つぶしに最適だろー」
lines.english: “Exactly. Chitose, you’re perfect for killing time.”

lines.japanese: 「いやぁ、そーすかぁ？」
lines.english: “Oh, am I?”

lines.japanese: 「うん。だから邪魔」
lines.english: “Yeah. That’s why you’re in the way.”

lines.japanese: 「ひどい！　傷付いた！　男子便所に英里子さんのケータイ番号書いて、読者のイマジネーション掻きたてる一口コメント添えてやる！　うわああああん！！」
lines.english: “Cruel! I'm wounded! I'll write your phone number in the men's room and add one teasing little line to inflame the reader's imagination! Waaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 「っせーなあ。便所ぐらい静かに行けよ……」
lines.english: “God, you’re loud. At least go to the toilet quietly...”

lines.japanese: ……ふぅ。
lines.english: ...Phew.

lines.japanese: 帰れだって。
lines.english: She told me to go home.

lines.japanese: ……くすん。
lines.english: ...Sniff.

lines.japanese: 仕方ない……帰るか……。
lines.english: Oh, well... I suppose I’ll go...

lines.japanese: ……っと、と、と、忘れてた！
lines.english: ...Oh, oh, oh—I forgot!

lines.japanese: そそそ、アナタがいたんでしたね。やー、ははは、すいません。ついたそがれちゃって。
lines.english: R-right, right. You were here, weren't you? Ahaha, sorry. I got all mopey there.

lines.japanese: たびたびこんな所から申しわけありませんね。ま、そんな感じで、千歳鷲介のとある日常をお送りしたわけですが。
lines.english: Forgive me for addressing you from a place like this yet again. And there you have it: one ordinary day in the life of Shusuke Chitose.

lines.japanese: や、でも、アナタ退屈じゃないですか？　なにも言わずに俺の話聞いてるだけなんて。
lines.english: But aren't you bored? Sitting there without a word, doing nothing but listening to me?

lines.japanese: いえ、いいんですけどね俺は。わりと喋るのは好きな方なんで。
lines.english: I mean, I don't mind. I do kinda like talking.

lines.japanese: で、俺、このまま続けていいんすか？
lines.english: So, uh, am I good to keep going?

lines.japanese: いいみたいっすね。はい、おっけー。
lines.english: Looks like that’s a yes. Okay, cool.

lines.japanese: ええ、それじゃまあ、引きつづき千歳鷲介くんの物語をお送りしますんで。良かったら便座にでも腰かけて。良かったら出すもの出しながら。ね、気長にひとつ。
lines.english: Then let's continue with the story of young Shusuke Chitose. If you like, have a seat on the toilet. Let out whatever needs letting out while you listen. Settle in and take your time.

lines.japanese: そんなカンジで。よろしくニューフェイス。
lines.english: Anyway, you get the idea. Glad to have you along, stranger.
